description_text: Mission The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning. Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.   Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies What You'll Do Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++. Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability. Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities. Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform. Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases. Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.   An ideal candidate should have Required: 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM). Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code. Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability. Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software. Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant). Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions. Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus. A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users. Preferred / Bonus: Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks. Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load). Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions. Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications. Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications. Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management. What we offer A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience. A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker. Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect). description_text: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? Where do customers drop out of the journey from acquisition to activation? What drives repeat usage, retention and churn? Which product changes improve conversion, customer value or commercial performance? How should we prioritise product investments across markets and customer segments? If you're motivated by meaningful analytical work, enjoy translating complexity into clarity, and want to see your insights directly influence both product decisions and commercial outcomes, this role is for you. What you'll do Analyse customer behaviour and product performance across the full consumer lifecycle — from acquisition and activation through engagement, retention, churn and reactivation . Identify opportunities to improve conversion, customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis, customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments, markets, channels and product journeys, helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes, such as activation, conversion, repeat usage, retention, churn, customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions, translating complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations. Define, monitor and communicate core SumUp Consumer KPIs, covering acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, churn and customer value. Design, execute and analyse A/B tests and product experiments, assessing both customer impact and commercial impact. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use, proactively surfacing trends, anomalies, performance risks and growth opportunities. Help Product Managers assess the expected impact of opportunities and evaluate whether product investments are delivering the intended customer and business outcomes. Partner with Analytics Engineering to ensure KPI definitions, business logic and product instrumentation are accurate, scalable and trusted. Bring a curious eye to AI and machine learning techniques, including LLM-assisted analysis, to speed up insight generation, customer understanding and product measurement. You'll be great for this role if… You have strong SQL skills and are comfortable querying, analysing and validating data in a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery or similar. You have hands-on experience with product analytics techniques such as funnel analysis, cohort analysis, segmentation and behavioural analysis. You understand the commercial drivers of a digital product, including customer acquisition, conversion, activation, retention, churn and customer lifetime value. You can connect customer behaviour and product performance to business outcomes, and use data to identify growth opportunities and inform prioritisation. You've worked on A/B tests or product experiments, with a solid grounding in the statistics behind them. You're proficient in a visualisation tool such as Looker, Tableau or Power BI, with a track record of building dashboards that stakeholders actually use. You can translate ambiguous product or business questions into structured analysis, and explain findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences alike. You're comfortable assessing trade-offs, challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence. You're curious about how AI and emerging techniques can improve product measurement, experimentation, customer understanding and commercial decision-making. You're comfortable managing multiple workstreams and stakeholders, with strong prioritisation and a proactive communication style. This is a chance to work on complex engineering challenges with massive real-world impact. You will work alongside a sharp, collaborative team and ship production systems end-to-end. If you are comfortable pairing with AI tools to write code and want to build systems that ingest, verify, and deliver data at scale, this role might be the right one for you. What you will do Build and scale services that extract structured data from regulatory documents. Design and maintain tooling to ensure data correctness across ingestion pipelines. Deploy and operate containerized apps in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Pair with AI coding tools as part of your regular development workflow. Contribute to technical architecture and help shape the engineering culture. Your profile 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong skills in Python. "AI-native": comfortable and effective pairing with AI tools to write code. Hands-on experience with data extraction at scale. Senior-level experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure). Proficiency with Git, CLI tools, and containerized deployments (Docker). Clear communicator who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced environment. Comfortable working hybrid in our Munich office. Nice to Have: Experience with regulatory or compliance data. Experience with ML pipelines or Large Language Models (LLMs). Full-stack skills (React, Angular, or Vue). Why us? A vibrant in-office culture in Munich with the option for up to 60 % work from home. Flexible working hours. 30 vacation days per year (including 4 “company rest days” over christmas). 30 days of "workation" per year, within the EU and selected countries. High autonomy and flat hierarchies. EGYM Wellpass for unlimited access to fitness courses and gyms. Udemy access for educational videos. Closing Certivity is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation. job_title: UVC Partners: Data & AI - Master Thesis / Internship (f/m/x)
description_text: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own. What we offer Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! Diversity is important to us Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. Contact Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany www.uvcpartners.com UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer. UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM. <p><strong>Global Solutions Architect - Cloud</strong><br><br><strong>About the role</strong><br>Rubrik Professional Services is hiring a Global Solutions Architect to serve as our most senior technical authority for public cloud. This is a global, individual-contributor role at Technical Director level. You will set the architectural direction for how Rubrik is designed, deployed, and operated in the world’s most demanding cloud environments, and you will carry that direction personally into our most strategic customer engagements.</p> <p>You will be deployed where technical risk is highest: flagship accounts, first-of-a-kind architectures, and the engagements whose outcome sets the pattern everyone else follows. Between those engagements, you will convert what you learned into the reference architectures, service offerings, and enablement that raise the capability of every architect and consultant in the field. Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially. As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate. And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time. What you'll do at UiPath Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams. Apply and adapt frontier ML, forecasting, and optimisation techniques — and increasingly agentic AI — to problems that don’t have a textbook answer. Turn what works on the ground into product direction, so each engagement makes our core capability better for the next customer. Operate with genuine autonomy across a wide range of stakeholders — from data scientists to customer executives — and make the judgment calls that get things shipped. Stay at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI, and bring it back to the team. What you'll bring to the team Strong track record applying ML / data science to real-world commercial problems, ideally with depth in forecasting, optimisation, or supply-chain / pricing. The instinct to own outcomes, not tasks — you take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a result rather than waiting to be told the next step. Fluent programming (Python and SQL) and the ability to pick up whatever a problem demands. Excellent communication — you can take a customer executive from confusion to confidence, and explain a complex model to a non-technical room. Comfort with ambiguity, direct customer contact, and the pace of a team that ships. Bonus: experience with agentic / LLM-based systems, or building ML in production. Who thrives here We’re looking for builders — smart, switched-on people who want to be handed a genuinely hard real-world challenge and go to town on it. If you want to work at the frontier of applied AI, own something that matters, and see your work land with real customers and shape a product, this is for you. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy . We are building the world's decision infrastructure: the strategic twin of every industrial organization for complex combinatorial problems. We unlocked what wasn't possible before: mapping reality with its levers and constraints into a computer, then running n-dimensional optimization on critical value-chain decisions. We help Europe stay strong and the German Mittelstand make good decisions between market shifts, orders, machines and people. Founded by Dana (CEO) and Erik (CTO) from RWTH research, backed by a €2.8M round led by Vorwerk Ventures, with customers live on our optimization models. We move fast. We care. No patience for problems left unsolved. Your mission Hi, I'm Erik, CTO of Circonomit. This ad is specific on purpose: you should be able to tell from it whether this is your job. We build decision infrastructure for industrial companies: our customers model their production, with its capacities, costs and constraints, and we compute the answer to "what should we do?" before the decision is made. Your mission: scale our data platform for multiple customers and domains. Customer data arrives in many formats from many sources, ERP exports included; it has to land in our system consistently, stay manageable at millions of records, and be fast to query when models and results are on-screen. The product is a data-heavy web app with a math-heavy backend (Python, TypeScript, Solid.js, Postgres, on Cloudflare): your center of gravity is data and infrastructure, but you touch the whole stack. We are looking for a system thinker who wants to shape the architecture. We will not sugarcoat it: short deadlines, real workload, and a platform that grows while customers already run on it. What you'll own The data platform end to end: ingestion, storage, and the query paths that keep millions of records fast on screen. You design it, you build it, you run it in production. The platform layer, directly with the CTO: infrastructure, deployments, and the path to production for the whole team. Performance and correctness work in the optimization engine, together with our research engineers. Your features from first line to production: nobody hands you a ticket and waits. How we work Small team, short lines of communication, no layers. You own your features end to end: you build them, you ship them to production yourself, you run them. Feedback runs both ways, and it runs continuously, in daily work and in weekly one-on-ones. We talk as equals. We communicate proactively and flag it early when something isn't working out. Saying no is part of the job. We like this work, and you'll notice. We review each other's code, and we like being together in the Cologne office, because the fastest conversations still happen in a room. Requirements 5+ years building production backend or data-intensive systems. Strong Python and solid TypeScript, with the appetite to work in both daily. Analytics-data experience: real SQL depth, plus any of Parquet/Arrow/DuckDB/dbt/warehouse internals. Production PostgreSQL (multi-tenant, migrations, performance). Data pipelines over heterogeneous sources (ERP exports, Excel, CSV) onto object storage (S3 or comparable), built to keep working as customers and formats grow. Distributed systems and API design: typical failure modes, HTTP/auth/caching, sane versioning and error behavior. Engineering craft: design patterns, CI/CD pipelines you set up yourself, prototypes you can throw away. You have worked in a team, not mostly alone, and you know from experience which agile practices carry their weight. You have experience working with Linear, Jira, or a similar project management tool. You communicate proactively, too much rather than too little, and you organize yourself and your work. German at C1 or better, and fluent English. Team life runs in German; code and docs are English. NRW-based (Cologne office), optionally Munich, Stuttgart, Berlin area or else willing to work hybrid. Open to find a way if we fit. Nice to have: a substantial migration you carried out end to end (system, stack, or data) · telemetry and observability · Cloudflare or comparable serverless infrastructure · frontend experience, ideally with Solid.js or another reactive framework · optimization/OR exposure · manufacturing or ERP data experience. You are structured and biased for action, and you have shown you play to win wherever life has put you so far. This role is not for you if you want a clearly defined box, or work handed to you in tickets. We are a small team, pre-Series A: structures and processes are still being built, by us and by you. Priorities shift with customers, and some weeks a deadline bends the plan. Benefits Impact.  You see your results in the real world, fast. The problems are concrete (production plans, capacities, logistics), and customers can measure in euros what your work changed. Ownership.  What you build, you ship, and you own it once it runs. No layers between you and production, no approval chain that turns your decision into someone else's. The people next to you.  You work directly with the CTO on the platform layer, and with the math and OR team on the optimization engine. Shaping.  The processes are still forming, and whoever shows up with a better way of doing things gets to install it. This is a place for system thinkers: the interesting part is seeing how the pieces fit and where they will break. The company is early, and your scope will grow with it. Feedback speed.  You will know where you stand. We say things out loud, we adjust, and we expect the same from you. High stakes.  Competitive salary and relevant room in the equity package (VSOP) to match your contribution and your career development. The basics.  Hardware of your choice · AI tooling budget · sports membership · Deutschland-Ticket. Process: first conversation, 20 minutes, with me or with the engineer who owns our frontend. Second conversation with the two of us together; this is where the technical questions get deep. Then a hands-on challenge, about three hours of your time, followed by a 45-minute walkthrough where you explain your solution and the decisions behind it. Finally, the team: online first, then in person at the office. Both sides decide. Two to three weeks end to end, and you hear back within days after each step. Before you decide, ask us to put you on a call with someone who will tell you the good, the bad and the ugly. To apply: skip the cover letter. Tell us about your favorite system you have built, and one decision in it you would reverse today. "Hustle the day, analyze at night, reinforce something outstanding." Period. job_title: Director of Engineering, Frontend technologies, Marketplace Technologies
description_text: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>Brief info about Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p data-renderer-start-pos="1"><span data-sheets-root="1">Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third. <br>The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:<br><br><strong><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/marketplace" target="_blank">Vinted Marketplace</a></strong> is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedgo" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Go</strong></a> enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.<br><br><a href="https://careers.vinted.com/vintedpay" target="_blank"><strong>Vinted Pay</strong></a> is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.<br><br>Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.&nbsp;</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold:&nbsp;</p> <ol> <li><strong>Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency</strong>: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.</li> <li><strong>Drive strategic engineering initiatives</strong>: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web.&nbsp;</li> </ol> <p>You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.</p> <p>You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.</p> <h2><strong>In this position, you will</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategically:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Ensure the most effective frontend setup for the Marketplace.</strong> We have 40+ teams, each with 3 frontend engineers (iOS, Android, and Web) in the Marketplace unit. We know this will look different in two years. Deciding what different means, and getting 9 product domains to fund it, is the job</li> <li><strong>Drive Technology Strategy:</strong> Set and drive the future technology strategy for frontends, establishing a modular, scalable architecture that enables rapid development and strategic growth. Basically - raise the technological bar for all Marketplace unit.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Refine the domain's identity: </strong>Take sole ownership of shaping its future, successfully integrating Design Systems and engineering to treat our frontend platforms as a cohesive product.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Tactically</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Lead frontends:</strong> Lead a horizontal, platform-focused domain containing Android, iOS, Web, and Design System teams.</li> <li><strong>Lead Initiatives:</strong> Oversee Marketplace-wide technical tooling, core libraries, and frameworks. Lead strategic projects, i.e., frontend modularization and modernization (SwiftUI/Jetpack Compose), native automated testing.</li> <li><strong>Elevate global UI quality:</strong> Integrate design systems and accessibility into the frontend ecosystem to consolidate technical, visual and interaction quality standards. Support UI experimentation.</li> <li><strong>Ensure Resilience &amp; Reliability:</strong> Maintain robust release processes, Marketplace frontend quality, and performance monitoring to reduce downtime and ensure a consistent member experience.</li> <li><strong>Innovate &amp; Optimize:</strong> Drive AI-efficiency enablement in frontend development and explore cross-platform frontend development opportunities to increase engineering speed and productivity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A lot of this work will be influencing without formal authority</strong>: Champion the frontend technical vision among your director peers, influencing the leaders of 9 Product domains to accommodate and prioritize platform-wide changes across 40+ teams.</p> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <p><strong>How much of a technical acumen? </strong>Enough to have in depth conversations with our direct reports. You will have 4 strong technical EMs reporting to you, as well as 3 world-class staff engineers. We don’t think you need to match their technical competencies (that’s a stretch!), but you have to be able to speak their language, understand problems at their essence, and be able to consolidate and multiply their inputs, including being able to disagree objectively.</p> <p><strong>Leadership: </strong>you have a track record of making level change in the organizations that you lead (rather than 20% change). Consolidating your team views and making coherent strategy out of those views is step one. Step two is even more important: being able to implement these changes in your domain, and more so - across other domains in the marketplace - is a foundational ability you carry. In practice, that means you have at least 2 years of experience leading leaders and 5 years of experience influencing without authority.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Change horizon:</strong> You are comfortable holding two timeframes at once. We need someone who can say, "Here is what our frontend setup should look like in two years, and here is why" AND name the clear deliverable that has to ship in the first quarter to make that end state reachable. Leaders who only do the second are common. Leaders who only do the first are entertaining. We need both.</p> <p><strong>What this role is not:</strong> This is not a hands-on frontend or release-engineering role. You will not be tuning CI, owning the release train, or reviewing architecture decisions yourself — you’ll have 4 strong EMs and 3 Staff Engineers close to the details, and your job is to turn their technical judgment into direction, alignment, and organizational change. If your strongest work is deep in the mechanics, you'll be underused here. If your strongest work is changing how 40+ teams operate, you'll be busy.</p> <h2><strong>Work perks&nbsp; </strong></h2> <ul> <li>The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme</li> <li>30 days of paid annual leave</li> <li>Newest MacBook models</li> <li>Digital mental and emotional health support and Employee Assistant Program (EAP)</li> <li>Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture</li> <li>A daily lunch allowance</li> <li>Frequent team-building events</li> <li>A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted</li> <li>A subsidised gym membership with ClassPass or Urban Sports Club</li> <li>A subsidised pension plan provided by Vinted</li> <li>Hallesche Supplemental health insurance</li> <li>Life and disability insurance provided</li> <li>A subsidised Deutschlandticket</li> <li>The opportunity to spend up to 90 days per year - 21 of which can be spent working outside of the EU - on workation</li> <li>A dog-friendly office</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Working at Vinted&nbsp;</strong></h2> <p><strong>Individual Learning Budget</strong></p> <p>We invest in your professional growth! As part of our commitment to continuous learning, we offer an annual learning budget to support your personal and career development through courses, certifications, workshops and more.</p> <p><strong>Hybrid Work</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>We’ve adopted a hybrid workplace model where 2 days in the office are recommended but not enforced. It’s up to you and your team to decide on the exact days you’ll spend working together in person.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity</strong></p> <p>The Vinted Group is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people from all walks of life feel a sense of belonging. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and life experiences. At Vinted, all applicants are treated fairly without regard to their race, age, religion or belief, sex, national origin, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">The annual gross salary range for this position is:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€124.300</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€168.100 EUR</span></div></div></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Your mission You are responsible for the operational management of our software development and ensure that our Backend and Frontend teams can deliver reliably and with clear focus. You manage planning, capacities, dependencies, and releases and keep the entire development process in view. You lead our Development Leads and development teams both functionally and disciplinarily. You establish clear responsibilities, develop team members, and ensure that problems and blockers are identified and resolved early. You coordinate teams and tickets throughout their full lifecycle, continuously improve our development and project processes, and ensure transparent and realistic planning for all relevant stakeholders. You are the central interface between Engineering and Product Management. Product owns product strategy, prioritization, and requirements; together with the Development Leads, you ensure these are translated into technically sound, realistically planned, and reliably delivered solutions. This is not a traditional IT project management role: you bring a strong technical background yourself and can make architecture and design decisions together with our Development Leads, assess technical risks, and evaluate different solution approaches. Alongside short-term delivery, you also keep long-term technical topics in view, including architecture, maintainability, security, technical debt, and the continuous improvement of our engineering standards. You actively drive our AI First Development Culture. This goes far beyond AI-assisted coding: you identify opportunities to integrate AI into research, technical conception, architecture, project planning, development, testing, reviews, debugging, documentation, and other development processes, and help the team use these tools effectively. Your profile You have at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in or around software development and have worked hands-on as a software developer yourself. You bring proven experience leading developers and development teams and have already held both functional and disciplinary leadership responsibility. You have experience managing software development projects: you have coordinated multiple developers and stakeholders, owned planning and timelines, managed dependencies, and guided releases through to delivery. You are technically deep enough to understand and shape architecture decisions, identify technical risks early, and discuss technical topics with experienced developers at eye level. You bring strong experience in at least one of our technology areas: Python-based backend development, ideally with Django / Django REST Framework or FastAPI, or modern frontend development with React and TypeScript. Experience with the other area is a plus. Gemeinsam mit anderen Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und Product Owner*innen baust du die Features der Zukunft unserer Hosting-Verwaltung. Mit TypeScript, Go oder Node.js sowie verschiedenen Code-Generatoren entwickelst du eventbasierte Microservices. Falls es dich interessiert, ist hier unser vollständiger Tech-Stack des Kundencenters: Go, TypeScript, Node.js, React, REST, Open API, gRPC, CQRS, Eventsourcing, DDD, Postgres, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, n8n und Temporal als Workflow-Engine, GitLab, Monitoring (Jaeger, Sentry, Prometheus, Grafana) Das erwartet dich: Entwicklung (Konzeptionierung, Planung und Umsetzung) unserer interaktiven und responsiven Webanwendungen sowie Neuentwicklungen, egal ob Fullstack oder Backend Pflege und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden Webservices Du arbeitest aktiv in Design- und Code-Sprints mit, bei denen du deinen Ideen freien Lauf lassen kannst und auch mal out-of-the-box denkst Unit-/Integration-Tests und strikte Typings geben dir beim Entwickeln die nötige Sicherheit In einem Team aus Gleichgesinnten entwickelst du unsere Produkte weiter und probierst auch einfach mal Dinge aus, um so unseren hohen Qualitätsanspruch umzusetzen und die Kunden langfristig zu begeistern Das bieten wir dir: Sicherheit & Perspektive Wir arbeiten mit zukunftsweisenden Technologien und bauen Systeme, wenn nötig, lieber selbst, statt auf Fertiglösungen zu setzen. Das bringt Herausforderungen und ein technisches Niveau, das nicht alltäglich ist und dich fachlich weiterbringt. Geek paradise Egal ob Kubernetes, Microservices oder React - bei uns kannst du das richtig nice Zeug machen. Damit du dein Bestes geben kannst, bist du der Admin auf deinem Gerät und hast die freie Wahl bei deiner Hardware und der Ausstattung deines Arbeitsplatzes. Aktiver Teil der Community Wir sind Teil der Open Source und Linux Community. Teile unseres Stacks stellen wir zur freien Verfügung, entwickeln von uns genutzte Open Source Projekte aktiv weiter und sponsern Projekte und Events im Open Source Kontext. Und wir unterstützen deine Community-Arbeit. Deine Entwicklung Wir wollen, dass du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst. Dabei unterstützen wir dich aktiv durch Weiterbildungen, Schulungen und unser Coaching-Angebot. Du siehst ein spannendes Thema, das dich und uns voranbringt? Dann nimm dir die Zeit, dich damit zu beschäftigen. Dein Einfluss Mitdenker gesucht! Wir geben deinen Ideen Raum und sind offen für Neues. So entwickeln wir uns als Unternehmen stetig weiter. Du möchtest was bewegen? Bring dich ein und lass deinen Gedanken freien Raum. Wir leben echte Mitbestimmung - unabhängig von Rolle und Titel. Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden Du kannst dich auf Angebote rund um deine körperliche und mentale Gesundheit (wie Sportnavi, aktive Pause, etc.), unser Fahrradleasing und Corporate Benefits freuen. Natürlich ist bei uns auch für Vitamine, Koffein & H2O gesorgt. Das bringst du mit: Du hast bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen Du kennst dich bspw. mit Node.js, Go oder TypeScript sehr gut aus Du kannst mit Git als Versionskontrollsystem, Pull Request-Workflows und üblichen CI-Lösungen sowie Docker und Rest umgehen Kreativität, Humor und eine Leidenschaft für neue Technologien gehören für dich zum täglichen Doing dazu Der sichere Umgang mit dem Meme-Generator ist für dich genauso selbstverständlich wie der exzellente Aufbau eines Lego Todessterns Kontaktperson: Robert Lipkowski Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Unternehmensbeschreibung "Buying Labs is the leading global partner for sourcing and distributing premium consumer goods!" Wir suchen einen Product Engineer (m/w/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Tech-Teams bei Buying Labs - idealerweise am Standort Hamburg oder, wenn es fachlich und persönlich gut passt, auch remote. In dieser Position verbindest du fundierte technische Fähigkeiten mit ausgeprägtem Produktdenken. Du entwickelst mithilfe von KI Tools und Funktionen, die echten Mehrwert für unsere Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie für unser Unternehmen schaffen. Dabei verantwortest du Features ganzheitlich - von der Definition des Umfangs und der Konzeption über die Entwicklung und Bereitstellung bis hin zur erfolgreichen Einführung und Nutzung. In jeder Phase setzt du KI ein, um intelligentere Lösungen schneller zu entwickeln. Diese Position richtet sich an Menschen, die gerne etwas aufbauen und denen die Wirkung ihrer Arbeit wichtig ist: Menschen, die sowohl die Perspektive der Nutzerinnen und Nutzer als auch die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse verstehen, den erforderlichen Entwicklungsumfang klar definieren können und die geplanten Lösungen anschließend erfolgreich umsetzen. Deine Aufgaben Ganzheitliche Produktentwicklung: Du verantwortest Features vom ersten Konzept bis zum Einsatz in der Produktivumgebung und bei echten Nutzerinnen und Nutzern – nicht nur den Code. Du lieferst vollständige Lösungen, die einen messbaren geschäftlichen Mehrwert schaffen. Dabei konkretisierst du Anforderungen, definierst technische Lösungsansätze und setzt Funktionen sowohl im Frontend als auch im Backend um. Qualität wird von Anfang an berücksichtigt und durch geeignete Tests sichergestellt. Produktdenken und Nutzerorientierung: Du verstehst die Bedürfnisse unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer sowie die zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse und leitest daraus ab, was entwickelt werden sollte und warum. Produktideen und Anforderungen verschiedener Stakeholder verwandelst du in überzeugende Lösungen, die tatsächlich genutzt werden. Integration von KI in unsere Produkte: Du konzipierst und integrierst KI-gestützte Funktionen in unsere Plattform. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Einsatz von Programmierassistenten, sondern um die Entwicklung konkreter KI-Lösungen für reale Herausforderungen unserer Nutzerinnen und Nutzer. Du erkennst Potenziale, bei denen KI Arbeitsabläufe beschleunigen, Entscheidungen verbessern oder völlig neue Möglichkeiten eröffnen kann. Datenmodellierung und skalierbare Systeme: Du entwickelst solide Datenmodelle und skalierbare Architekturen, die eine zuverlässige Grundlage für unsere Produkte bilden. Wiederkehrende Aufgaben überführst du in gemeinsam nutzbare Bausteine – beispielsweise UI-Komponenten, Datenimportprozesse oder KI-Pipelines. Dadurch lässt sich jedes neue Tool schneller entwickeln als das vorherige. Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern und Förderung der Nutzung: Du arbeitest mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen zusammen – von der Geschäftsleitung bis zu den operativen Teams –, um Prioritäten abzustimmen und die erfolgreiche Einführung und Nutzung neuer Tools und Funktionen voranzutreiben. Technische Konzepte vermittelst du verständlich und schaffst organisationsweit Akzeptanz für deine Lösungen. Kontinuierliche Verbesserung: Du holst frühzeitig Feedback ein, entwickelst Lösungen in kurzen Zyklen weiter und verbesserst deine Arbeit kontinuierlich. Du hältst dich über neue Technologien und bewährte Engineering-Praktiken auf dem Laufenden, damit unsere Tools und Systeme den geschäftlichen Anforderungen stets einen Schritt voraus sind und unsere Plattform wettbewerbsfähig bleibt. About Plane Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together. Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 55,000+ stars, 5,000+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship. Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules. Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work. Humans and agents We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's. Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives. This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that. About the role Our largest customers do not buy Plane off the shelf. A bank wants it behind their firewall with SSO tied to their identity provider; a defense contractor wants it air-gapped with a migration plan from three legacy tools at once. You will own the technical architecture for these deployments before the contract is signed and after, translating what a customer's infrastructure and compliance team requires into a Plane deployment that actually holds up. You will work directly with sales on the largest deals we run and with engineering when a customer's requirements push past what we support today. This role exists because our regulated-industry customers ask questions our sales team cannot answer alone, and our engineers should not have to answer on every call. What you'll do Own the technical architecture for enterprise and regulated-industry deployments, from the first discovery call through a signed statement of work. Design self-hosted and air-gapped Plane deployments that satisfy a specific customer's security review, not a generic best-practice checklist. Run technical discovery with customers whose infrastructure and compliance teams will pick apart every answer you give, and be right often enough that they trust the next one. Define the migration path when a customer moves off two or three existing tools at once, including what data does not survive the move and saying so up front. Work daily with sales on live deals and with engineering when a customer's requirements expose a real gap in the product, carrying that gap back as a specific, scoped request rather than a vague one. Answer the same security questionnaire in a slightly different format for the fourth time this month, because every regulated buyer's procurement process is its own small bureaucracy and none of them read each other's paperwork. What you'll bring You have designed and defended a technical architecture to a skeptical buyer , and you can walk us through one deal where the customer's own security or infrastructure team changed your design. You understand self-hosted and on-premises deployment beyond a docker-compose file , including networking, SSO and identity federation, and what changes when a customer runs the software instead of you. You can read a security questionnaire or compliance requirement and translate it into an actual deployment decision , not a reassurance. You are comfortable being the technical voice on a sales call , including the parts where the answer is no or not yet. You write technical documentation a customer's own engineers will actually follow , because you will not be in the room when they run it. Nice to haves You have worked pre-sales or post-sales in a solutions architecture, sales engineering, or technical account management role selling to regulated industries. You have contributed to Plane, run it self-hosted, or maintained another open project people rely on. You have shipped or supported deployments into banking, defense, healthcare, or air-gapped environments specifically. You have opinions about how AI agents should be permissioned and audited in an enterprise environment, and can defend them. Tech Backend : Python/Django, Golang, Node.js, Postgres, Redis Messaging : RabbitMQ, Kafka Infrastructure : AWS, Kubernetes, Rancher, self-hosted deployment via Docker and Helm Identity : SAML, OIDC, SCIM Everyday tools : GitHub, Plane (yes, we run on it), Figma, Slack Why Plane? Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead. The scope is real. We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both. The constraints make you better. job_title: Team Lead - Site Reliability Engineering (all genders)
description_text: Introduction FACT-Finder builds product discovery technology for eCommerce and is trusted by leading online shops across Europe with its two products Next Generation and Infinity. We are actively modernizing our hosting toward Kubernetes on Harvester – as an on-prem hybrid with the option to scale fully into the cloud in the mid-term. As Team Lead Site Reliability Engineering (all genders), you own the reliability, scalability, and cost of our hosting environments, drive this transformation end-to-end, and lead the team that delivers it. Your mission You own the operational health of our hosting across on-premise (Frankfurt, Stockholm) and cloud – availability, performance, and incident management. You actively drive the modernization toward Kubernetes on Harvester: cluster topology, storage (Longhorn), networking (VLAN, load balancing, ingress), backup, and disaster recovery. You build a production-grade k8s platform: lifecycle, upgrades, RBAC, secrets, GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), observability, and policy guardrails. You shape the NG Search Operator (custom Kubernetes operator) and solve auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler) for the current architecture. You concretely define our on-prem hybrid model: which workloads run where, how we burst into the cloud, how we keep latency and cost under control – while keeping the architecture portable enough for a future cloud-only move. You own capacity planning and hosting cost and turn cost into a deliberate, managed lever. You lead and develop our currently 4-person Hosting team, own performance and technical direction, and set the standards and ownership culture. You make AI a core part of our operations: diagnosis, automation, monitoring, and insight. Your profile Strong background in infrastructure or platform engineering across on-premise and cloud. Hands-on depth with Kubernetes in production: cluster lifecycle, upgrades, networking, storage, RBAC, observability, GitOps delivery. Proven people leadership experience, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ideally practical experience with Harvester or comparable HCI/virtualization platforms (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack). Experience leading a real migration from bare metal / classic VMs to a k8s-based platform – including stateful workloads, storage migration, cutover, and rollback. Comfort designing or operating Kubernetes operators (custom controllers / CRDs), ideally for stateful systems like search, databases, or streaming. Solid grasp of auto-scaling primitives (HPA, VPA, cluster autoscaler, KEDA) and how they interact with capacity planning on-prem and in the cloud. Experience with on-prem hybrid architectures and owning reliability, capacity, and cost for production systems. Hands-on fluency with AI tools in day-to-day operations. Fluent English; German is a plus. THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe. Leadership with real scope: You lead an established team and shape our platform in a decisive phase of our transformation. Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right. AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword. Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role. Flexible work: Hybrid work model with a focus on outcomes. Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline. Attractive benefits: Competitive salary, modern equipment, learning budget, and regular team events. Job Location Berlin, Munich, Pforzheim or Stockholm (hybrid) Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Unsere MEDIVISE-Systeme verbinden Software, Hardware, Cloud-Infrastruktur und die deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur und schaffen neue Zugangspunkte zu ärztlicher Versorgung, Diagnostik und digitalen Gesundheitsleistungen. Dabei entwickeln wir eine offene Plattform für Anwendungen wie Videosprechstunden, digitale Ersteinschätzung, eRezept, eAU, Diagnostik und weitere digitale Gesundheitsservices. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine:n Software Developer (m/w/d) auf Junior- bis Mid-Level , der oder die unsere Plattform gemeinsam mit uns weiterentwickelt und mit wachsender Erfahrung eigene technische Bereiche übernimmt. Aufgaben Du entwickelst unsere Backend-Plattform mit Kotlin, Quarkus und PostgreSQL weiter. Du arbeitest an unseren Webanwendungen mit Flask, Jinja2 und HTMX . Du entwickelst BoxOS und bindest Hardware, Telematikinfrastruktur und weitere Geräte an. Du entwickelst und integrierst REST-APIs und externe Dienste. Du schreibst automatisierte Tests und arbeitest mit Code Reviews . Du unterstützt Deployments mit Docker, Helm, Kubernetes und GitHub Actions . Du dokumentierst technische Entscheidungen und unterstützt bei Analyse und Troubleshooting. Deine Arbeit wird dabei nicht für eine Demo entwickelt, sondern soll nach Entwicklung, Test und Review zuverlässig in unseren MEDIVISE-Systemen im realen Betrieb eingesetzt werden. Qualifikation Abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Medieninformatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eines vergleichbaren Fachgebiets – oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation mit entsprechender praktischer Erfahrung. Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer modernen Programmiersprache , zum Beispiel Kotlin, Java, Python, C# oder TypeScript. Sicherer Umgang mit Git und relationalen Datenbanken . Grundverständnis von HTTP, REST-APIs und Webanwendungen. Bereitschaft, dich in unterschiedliche Technologien und Teile unserer Plattform einzuarbeiten. Eigenständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise. Verantwortungsbewusstsein im Umgang mit sensiblen Gesundheitsdaten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, mindestens auf C1-Niveau. Von Vorteil sind erste Erfahrungen mit: Quarkus, Spring Boot oder Flask Docker, Kubernetes oder Helm GitHub Actions und CI/CD Terraform oder Ansible Linux- und Cloud-Infrastruktur MQTT und Edge-/IoT-Systemen Healthcare-IT, Telematikinfrastruktur, eGK/VSDM, HL7 oder FHIR KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag Benefits Sichtbare Wirkung: Deine Arbeit wird direkt in unseren MEDIVISE-Systemen und damit im realen Versorgungsalltag eingesetzt. Breites technisches Umfeld: Backend, Web, Edge-Geräte, Cloud und Healthcare-IT. Schnelle fachliche Entwicklung: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem technischen Team zusammen und übernimmst zunehmend Verantwortung. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Direkter Austausch und schnelle Abstimmungen. Saubere Entwicklungsprozesse: Code Reviews, Tests, CI/CD und dokumentierte Entscheidungen. Moderne Arbeitsmittel: Aktuelle Hardware sowie zeitgemäße Entwicklungs- und KI-Tools. 50.000–60.000 € Jahresbrutto bei Vollzeit, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung. Unbefristete Festanstellung. 40 Stunden pro Woche , Teilzeit nach Absprache möglich. 30 Tage Urlaub. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Homeoffice -Tage nach Absprache. Zentrales Büro in der Torstraße in Berlin. Gelegentliche Einsätze bei unseren Systemen vor Ort. Bewirb dich jetzt als Software Developer (all genders) und werde Teil unseres Teams in Berlin. Wir sind ein mehrfach ausgezeichneter AWS Consulting & Engineering Partner mit Büros in Wien, Hamburg und Belgrad und begleiten unsere Kunden als Trusted Advisor auf der gesamten Cloud Journey. Über die Rolle Was auch immer unsere Kunden im Bereich Data & AI auf AWS vorhaben, wir entwerfen und entwickeln es gemeinsam vom ersten Architecture Workshop bis in Production mit ihnen. Dafür suchen wir dich: als Senior Solutions Architect für Data & AI verantwortest du End-to-End Projekte in deinem Bereich und gestaltest unsere wachsende Data & AI Business Unit aktiv mit. Architektur & Delivery Du führst die Entwicklung und Implementierung skalierbare AWS-Architekturen für Data Platforms und Gen AI- / Agentic AI-Lösungen Du sorgst für Security, Performance, Reliability und Kosteneffizienz bei unseren Kunden (AWS Well-Architected) Du triffst Architekturentscheidungen samt Trade-offs – und dokumentierst sie so, dass Teams darauf aufbauen können Du übersetzt vage Business-Pain-Points in messbare technische Anforderungen und klare Ziele Du bringst Außenperspektive ein und hebst unsere bestehenden Standards auf das nächste Level. Du beteiligst dich bei technical Pre-Sales, Scoping von Projekten und arbeitest an der Erstellung der Statements of Work Data & AI Du entwickelst Generative AI und Agentic AI Solutions auf AWS Bedrock, mit Frameworks wie Strands Agents und Runtime- / Governance-Bausteinen wie Bedrock AgentCore Du entwickelst Agenten-Architekturen mit Tool Use und MCP-basierten Integrationen, Multi-Step-Orchestrierung und klar definierten Grenzen des Agent-Scopes Du baust Human-in-the-Loop-Patterns ein, von Approval-Steps und Eskalationslogik bis zu (teil-)automatisierten Review-Schleifen Du etablierst Evaluation und Qualitätssicherung für LLM- und Agent-Systeme Du zeigst Kunden, wie sie GenAI und Agentic AI pragmatisch und verantwortungsvoll einsetzen Consulting & Pre-Sales Du bist Trusted Technical Advisor für unsere Kunden Du unterstützt Pre-Sales und technische Workshops Du übersetzt komplexe Technik in klaren Business Value Knowledge Sharing Du bist Mentor:in für unsere Junior-Kolleg:innen Du bringst dich in interne Standards, Best Practices und Trainings ein und entwickelst diese mit uns weiter Dein Profil: Must-haves 5+ Jahre in Cloud, Data, Software oder ML Engineering – davon 2+ Jahre mit Ownership für End-to-End-Architekturen Starke Hands-on-Expertise mit AWS Fundierte Erfahrung in Data Engineering und ETL-Architekturen Erfahrung mit Generative / Agentic AI Projekten Sehr gute Python-Skills Verhandlungssicheres Englisch; Deutsch auf professionellem Niveau Nice-to-haves AWS-Zertifizierungen Erfahrung in Pre-Sales oder technischer Führung Erfahrung im Consulting oder in kundennahen Projekten Erfahrung mit AWS Connect Solide Erfahrung mit IaC (Terraform oder vergleichbar) Erfahrung mit LLM Customization / Fine-Tuning und Distillation Praktische MLOps-Erfahrung (Model Deployment, Monitoring, Lifecycle) Erfahrung mit Kafka/Streaming Erstklassige Benefits für deine Karriere! Attraktives Package mit teilweise variablem Gehaltsbestandteil, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung. Schneller, transparenter Hiring-Prozess (in der Regel max. 3 Gespräche, Angebot typischerweise innerhalb von 4 Wochen). Persönliches Mentoring und strukturiertes Onboarding ab Tag 1. AWS-Zertifizierungen komplett von uns bezahlt. Remote-freundliches Setup mit wenig Reisetätigkeit (max. 20 % im Jahresschnitt). Regelmäßige Team- und Afterwork-Events an unseren Standorten plus gemeinsame Offsites. Wenn das nach dir klingt, dann bewirb dich! Wir freuen uns, dich kennenzulernen! Du willst Frontend nicht nur lernen, sondern an echten Projekten anwenden. Bei uns baust du vom ersten Tag an mit, begleitet, aber nicht an der Seitenlinie. BRANDUNG ist eine unabhängige Digitalagentur in Berlin. Wir entwickeln Websites, Shops und Applikationen: für bekannte Marken ebenso wie für NGOs und gemeinnützige Organisationen. Gearbeitet wird in Teams aus Frontend, Backend, Design und Projektmanagement. Als Trainee arbeitest du in genau diesen Teams mit, mit einem festen Mentor oder einer festen Mentorin aus dem Frontend-Team an deiner Seite. Dein Spielfeld Was dich erwartet Ein 12-monatiges Traineeprogramm mit klarem Entwicklungsplan und dem Ziel der Übernahme Feste Mentoren, regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche, Zeit für Lernen im Arbeitsalltag Moderner Stack: TypeScript, React mit Next.js (App Router) oder Vue mit Nuxt 3 Code Reviews als Standard, Tests als Standard, keine Bastellösungen KI-gestützte Entwicklung als Normalfall, nicht als Experiment: Wir arbeiten intensiv mit KI, und du lernst von Anfang an, damit sauber und kritisch umzugehen Dein Alltag Du entwickelst Komponenten und Interfaces für die Websites, Shops und Applikationen unserer Kund:innen Du wächst von einzelnen Komponenten zu ganzen Features Du schreibst Tests und nimmst an Code Reviews teil, als Autor:in und als Reviewer:in Du achtest auf Barrierefreiheit und Performance, weil beides zum Handwerk gehört Du arbeitest im agilen Projektteam mit Backend, Design und Projektmanagement Deine Skills Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse und ein Gefühl dafür, wann Markup sauber ist JavaScript-Grundlagen: du verstehst, was dein Code tut, nicht nur dass er läuft Erste Berührung mit React oder Vue, egal ob aus Studium, Bootcamp, Umschulung oder eigenen Projekten Neugier auf KI-Tools und die Bereitschaft, deren Ergebnisse zu hinterfragen statt blind zu übernehmen Lust auf Feedback und die Fähigkeit, Fragen zu stellen, bevor du dich festfährst Deutsch auf sehr gutem Niveau, Englisch zum Lesen von Doku Formale Abschlüsse sind uns weniger wichtig als das, was du zeigen kannst. Ein GitHub-Profil, ein Nebenprojekt oder eine Bootcamp-Abschlussarbeit sagen mehr als ein Zeugnis. Deine Benefits Das Frontend bei BRANDUNG umfasst über 30 Entwickler:innen in mehreren Teams mit jeweils eigener Teamleitung. Für deine Fragen gibt es damit immer mehr als eine Ansprechperson. Gemeinsam vor Ort , flexibel in der restlichen Woche. Mindestens zwei Tage pro Woche arbeiten wir gemeinsam im Berliner Office, die übrige Zeit teilst du dir selbst ein. Die Bürotage sind bewusst als gemeinsame Tage angelegt: Gerade in der Traineezeit lernst du im direkten Austausch deutlich schneller. Mittags kocht unser agentureigener Koch, jeden Tag frisch. Qualität ist fester Bestandteil unseres Prozesses . Code Reviews, automatisierte Tests mit verbindlichen Coverage-Grenzen, statische Codeanalyse und Error Monitoring sind in jedem Projekt gesetzt. Du arbeitest von Beginn an nach diesen Standards, statt sie dir später aneignen zu müssen. Wir entwickeln unsere KI-Werkzeuge selbst. Unser Code-Review-Agent und unsere Ticket-Automatisierung sind Eigenentwicklungen statt eingekaufter Tools. Wer daran mitarbeiten möchte, findet den Raum dafür, auch als Trainee. Deine Entwicklung verläuft strukturiert . Neben dem Mentoring führst du regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche mit deiner Teamleitung: Standortbestimmung, Ziele, konkreter Bedarf. Hinzu kommt ein Frontend-Format, in dem Kolleg:innen ihre aktuelle Arbeit vorstellen. Anfangs als Zuhörer:in, später mit eigenen Beiträgen. Kontaktinformationen Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und, falls vorhanden, einen Link zu Code oder Projekten. Kein Anschreiben nötig. Wir schauen uns jede Bewerbung persönlich an. Company Description Since its creation in 2007 in the financial city of Frankfurt am Main, Solactive AG has grown to one of the key players in the indexing space. The German multi-asset index provider focusses on tailor-made indices, offering to its clients a faster service, with greater flexibility and at a reasonable cost. Solactive AG and its subsidiaries have become one of the fastest growing index providers over the past few years and support the leading investment banks and asset managers across the globe. We have gained global recognition for our role in the Exchange Traded Fund (ETF) industry, where we rank among the top providers worldwide for underlying indices. We also excel in diverse areas such as Structured Products and investment mandates, showcasing the wide range of our capabilities. The impact and value we bring to the market is palpable, but also in the reputation we have proudly built by being close to our customers, solidifying Solactive AG as a trusted and reliable ally in the ever-evolving global financial landscape. Job Overview Our Structure team builds the software foundation for consistent, scalable index development at Solactive. We provide APIs, libraries, configuration patterns, testing frameworks, and reusable components for index construction workflows, supporting a great UX for ideation, production, and maintenance of new indices with clients. In this senior role, you will shape the technical architecture of a business-critical service that accelerates index development and improves quality across the index lifecycle. If you thrive on leading complex initiatives and shaping engineering excellence, we'd love to hear from you. Your Tasks Lead the technical direction and architectural evolution of the domain, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions for internal and external users of the index development service. Lead complex initiatives end-to-end: clarify ambiguous requirements, shape solution approaches, and drive implementation across backend, frontend, data, and infrastructure. Raise engineering standards through hands-on leadership, including code and design reviews, coaching, and a strong focus on simplicity, quality, and maintainability. Partner with product, business stakeholders, and engineering teams to identify core problems, challenge assumptions, and deliver solutions aligned with the platform vision. Drive system design across distributed services, APIs, integrations, data models, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring scalability, reliability, and operational readiness. Improve engineering effectiveness by refining processes, reducing friction, strengthening ownership, and enabling better trade-offs between speed, quality, and risk. Mentor engineers and support their growth in technical depth, ownership, and end-to-end delivery. Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes, including deploying, operating, and troubleshooting cloud-native applications in containerized environments. Ability to lead ambiguous, business-heavy problem spaces: identify real requirements and root problems, structure chaos, and translate needs into quality technical solutions. Proven track record of simplifying complex systems and delivering maintainable end-to-end solutions with high business impact. Strong experience with modern engineering practices: code reviews, design reviews, CI/CD, testing strategy, observability, incident response, and production ownership. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders without formal authority. Product mindset and delivery orientation: balances technical quality with business value and drives initiatives to completion. Experience with React and TypeScript frontend development is a plus. Job description We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Consultant to support a defined project at our Headquarters in Berlin. The assignment is focused on the set-up and further development of our data management and infrastructure platform. The initial consulting engagement is planned for six months, with the possibility of extending the assignment for a further period, potentially up to 12 months in total, subject to project requirements and mutual agreement. The consultant will provide specialist DevOps and data-platform expertise within the scope of the project. The assignment is structured as an independent consulting engagement, with responsibility for delivering agreed project outcomes and technical solutions. The project supports our Climate Policy Team, which is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, evaluation of emissions scenarios, the 1.5°C global warming limit and evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites. As part of the assignment, the consultant will work on the shared data platform and infrastructure used across the organisation. Our platform is self-hosted on our own hardware and currently runs PostgreSQL, MinIO, GitLab CI/CD and containerised workloads on Linux. The consultant is expected to organise and perform the assignment independently, within the agreed project scope and in coordination with relevant project stakeholders. Your responsibilities Build and operate the data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning DevOps and data engineering work. Take the platform from single-server deployments to properly separated environments, with orchestration and infrastructure as code. Establish and improve the platform's operational practices, including monitoring, alerting, incident response, capacity planning and performance optimisation. Design and implement the access, identity and secrets model across platform and shared infrastructure. Contribute to the standardisation of production data workflows and platform standards across the organisation. Document what you build (runbooks, architecture notes and handover material) to ensure continuity. Provide technical guidance to data analysts and scientists and support the adoption of good practice in DataOps, security and governance. Evaluate new tools and technologies, run proof-of-concepts, and help define the technical roadmap for our infrastructure. Your profile Relevant Tech Skills Required: Python and shell scripting. Linux servers in production. Container orchestration you have operated yourself, including cluster setup and upgrades (Kubernetes, Docker). Infrastructure as Code and configuration management (Ansible, or equivalent). Operational experience with PostgreSQL (backup and point-in-time recovery, tested restores, version upgrades and connection pooling). Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana) and alert design. A solid understanding of distributed systems in an on-premise context. Nice to have: S3-compatible object storage operations (MinIO, Ceph). Identity and directory services like LDAP, Keycloak, or SSO integration across self-hosted tools. Virtualisation platforms (Proxmox, KVM). Have actively applied data governance principles to manage data quality, security, and compliance, and understand how to implement controls that protect sensitive information. Some experience deploying AI projects. Proven ability to build automated pipelines that streamline development, testing and deployment for data-related projects. You are an excellent troubleshooter who excels at diagnosing and fixing data infrastructure and identifying performance bottlenecks. A strong communicator who can collaborate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international environment. Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).
